A BlitzLLVM extension: gives back what [SetGraphicsHDR](SetGraphicsHDR) is set to. The brightness of SDR white and the peak are the ones in use, so they are the ones of the system when none was set. Arguments that are left out are not written.
@param mode  The mode.
@param minimum  The darkest value in nits.
@param average  The brightness of SDR white in nits.
@param maximum  The brightest value in nits.
